Rinse the basil gently and dry thoroughly without wringing. Grate both cheeses and peel the garlic. Rub the garlic with salt in a mortar, add the basil and crushed pine nuts. At 3:03 that night — while I was still fast asleep — the morning briefing started by itself, turned on the lights, and began playing the news for me into the empty kitchen. And if that wasn't enough: the same system could say "good morning" at 3:30 in the morning if something detected movement in the bedroom.

en.Geofence + první motion v bytě → preset: Geofence + first motion in the apartment → preset = home → heating boost to schedule slot, lights released, multi-signal confirm (geofence + motion in 5 min) confirms return. Single-signal is ignored (false trigger protection).
en.Geofence GPS má rozptyl 30–50 m → kolemj: Geofence GPS has a spread of 30-50 m → passers-by, neighbors, driving by = false trigger
en.Geofence GPS na mobilu má rozptyl 30–50: Geofence GPS on a mobile phone has a range of 30-50m. When I drive by the house or am at the neighbors, the GPS can fall into the home zone even when I am not at home. Single-signal by trigger preset=home → heating boost → unnecessary consumption.
en.Geofence GPS opustí home zónu → multi-si: Geofence GPS leaves the home zone → multi-signal confirm with 5 min delay (eliminates false trigger with neighbors) → preset = away → cascade to all subsystems.
en.Geofence detekuje výjezd → preset = away: Geofence detects the exit → preset = away → heating 16 °C, lights blocked, or the robot starts the vacuum cleaner. Condition
Geofence detects the exit → preset = away → all zones drop to 16 °C. Returning home will automatically return the home preset from the current schedule slot.
en.Geofence enter = 1/3, ale GPS opustí okr: Geofence enter = 1/3, but GPS leaves the circuit in 1-2 min. Geofence_exit event before motion confirm → counter reset, arrival_pending cleared. No false positives.
en.Geofence enter = 1/3, motion v předsíni: Geofence enter = 1/3, motion in hall = 2/3 (knocking), DOOR_OPEN no (only opens after 30 seconds of silence). Multi-signal fails → arrival_pending expires in 5 min → away remains. It works.
en.Geofence enter event spustí flow „SH – R: Geofence enter event starts the flow "SH – Robot – Pause on arrival" — the robot receives a pause command, returns to the dock. The user does not come to the door with a starting vacuum cleaner. Cleaning will auto-resume in the evening (after sleep block expiration).
en.Geofence vstoupí + první motion v 5 min: Geofence enters + first motion in 5 min → preset = home. The heating will match the current schedule slot, audio released for briefing/comfort.

Cut the guanciale into strips and grate the pecorino. Bring the pasta water to a boil; salt it sparingly, both the guanciale and the cheese are salty. Dry-fry the guanciale over medium heat until it releases its fat and turns golden. Remove the pieces and leave the fat in the pan. Cook the spaghetti al dente according to the package. Set aside a cup of the pasta water before draining. In a bowl, mix the egg yolks with pecorino cheese and freshly ground pepper. Mix the spaghetti with the fat in the pan. Remove the pan from the heat, let it cool briefly and stir in the yolk mixture. Add the reserved water a spoonful at a time until the sauce is creamy. Return the guanciale, stir and serve immediately. After adding the yolks, do not boil the sauce anymore, so that the eggs do not curdle.

en.Před zapnutím sezóny jsem prošel všechno: Before turning on the season, I went through everything related to heating savings. An open window now sends the zone into frost protection and a closed one returns it, verified live with around a second response time. The temperature of the zone can be set directly from the kiosk in half degrees, and manual selection takes precedence in automatic mode. Boost on the kiosk used to add double, now it adds correctly. The thermal head of the consciously switched off zone, where the valve is faulty, no longer reports errors or a low battery. A new morning check tool verifies that nighttime dimming went as planned and subtracts AI corrections as well as morning bathroom heating to avoid false alarms. Two nights in automatic mode passed without a finding, and the first real departure from the apartment brought all zones down to 16 °C.

Three lines of code — sleep guard added in two places (prediction + rescue logic). The next night, nothing turns on by itself.

en.Přibyly dvě „pozorovatelské\" vrstvy. Pr: Two "observer" layers have been added. The first one evaluates every minute what mode the home is currently in (restful sleep, late-night toilet trip, morning wake-up call, someone leaving…) — and for each estimate it has a certainty score from 0 to 100. The second layer checks every 5 minutes that all key programs are running and fixes them itself for clearly-safe problems. In case of a critical problem, it sends a push notification to the phone.

en.Schedule slot „comfort\" — jídelna 21 °C: Schedule slot "comfort" — dining room 21 °C, bedroom 19 °C, bathroom 22 °C, toilet 18 °C. The boiler switches on every now and then for 5-15 minutes depending on the heat loss in the room. Hysteresis keeps the swing in the 0.6°C band.
en.Scheduler cron next tick (do 5 min) přep: Scheduler cron next tick (within 5 min) will recalculate targets according to the current schedule slot (afternoon comfort): dining room 21 °C, bedroom 19 °C, bathroom 22 °C, toilet 18 °C. Therefore, the wake-up rating deducted points every morning because "I'm still lying down" and the humidifier didn't turn on even once because the air was "humid enough." Diagnosis via Insights history showed the actual date of the last measurement. en.V sobotu ráno (budík 5:15) uživatel vsta: On Saturday morning (alarm 5:15) the user got up at 3:08, walked between rooms, but the routine never ran. Cause: the old logic waited for either an alarm or a double move in one zone within 3 minutes. When moving between zones, the sensors detected movement in each one only once. Meanwhile, the independent wake-up detector was reporting "strong yes" in 4 zones — but the morning routine wasn't listening to that signal. Fix: third trigger path — strong multi-zone signal + 10 minute trade-off filters night trips to the bathroom.

en.Visit Tuscany popisuje Piazza del Campo: Visit Tuscany describes the Piazza del Campo as a shell-shaped space, divided into nine sections reminiscent of the Rule of the Nine. The shape of the square is therefore worth observing as a whole: the sloping surface, the direction of the individual fields and the relationship to the Palazzo Pubblico. In an edge shot, these links can stand out better than when looking at just one building.
en.Visit Tuscany popisuje okolí Asciana jak: Visit Tuscany describes the area around Asciana as a clay hill with roads and trails. Erosion is also reflected in the shapes of the slopes. View field boundaries, the rhythm of trees and individual ridges. Their form changes according to the light, vegetation and harvest season.
en.Visit Tuscany výslovně upozorňuje na kře: Visit Tuscany expressly points out the fragility of the formation: it must not be walked on, touched or bathed in its immediate vicinity. Choosing a place to observe therefore also means respecting that the formation is not a staircase or a photo prop.
en.Visit Tuscany zasazuje Montepulciano na: Visit Tuscany places Montepulciano on the ridge separating the Val d'Orcia from the Valdichiana. It resembles the medieval layout of the city and distinctive Renaissance architecture. When visiting, it is therefore interesting to observe not only the individual houses, but also the rise itself: the street gradually changes height and opens up different views outside.

en.Vývar zahřej a udržuj horký. Cibuli nakr: Heat the broth and keep it hot. Finely chop the onion and let it vitrify in a little olive oil.

Heat the broth and keep it hot. Finely chop the onion and let it vitrify in a little olive oil. Add the rice and fry it briefly, stirring constantly. Stir in the passata and add a ladleful of hot stock. Cook over low to medium heat, stirring and ladlefuls of broth in. After about 16-18 minutes, depending on the rice, taste; the grains should remain on the bite. Set aside and stir in the cold butter, grana padano and torn basil. Aftertaste of salt. Let rest for 1-2 minutes. If the risotto is too thick, add a little hot stock and serve immediately.

It has protection against unsubstantiated AI physics conclusions; translucency, UV, thinness and indentation from a normal scan are not confirmed. In version 1.5.0, actual analyzed stamps are automatically saved individually in a collection with photos, unconfirmed AI designs and links to found web resources. Repeated registration does not create duplicates, deleted items do not restore themselves, and the entire collection can be moved to the recycle bin after confirmation. Simulations, aborted runs, and undefined slices are not saved. Saving is not confirmation of identity, status or price. Before verifying side-by-side, I check the marked L1/L2 faces and R1/R2 reverses, manually change the pairs and fix the cutouts. en.Na Campo Imperatore se cesta otevře do h: The road opens onto the mountain plateau of Campo Imperatore, while wooden fishing platforms called trabocchi stand over the sea along the coast. These are two very different sides of Abruzzo. I recommend giving each its own part of the trip rather than rushing between them.
en.Sem bych zamířil za velkým prostorem mez: I would come for the space between mountain villages, pastures and national parks. Coastal life centres on beaches and harbours; inland journeys reward a slower pace. A seaside base will not suit every mountain outing.
en.Na města a nižší polohy bych volil květe: For towns and lower ground, I would choose May, June or September. Plan high mountain walks around actual snow conditions and the forecast, rather than the season on the coast.
en.Pobřežní zastávky nejdřív porovnej ve vy: Start by checking trains for coastal stops. For several mountain villages in one day, I would consider a car. Check the final bus connection before booking accommodation.
en.V parku ověř konkrétní trasu a případná: Check the chosen trail and park restrictions before setting out. Stay on marked routes and keep your distance from wildlife.
en.Ke špízům bych si dal menší první chod m: I would order a small first course alongside the skewers rather than several meat dishes. For a meat-free meal, ask whether lentils or soup contain meat stock.
en.Kamenné domy pod Gran Sassem a místní čo: Stone houses below Gran Sasso and locally grown lentils tell a story of mountain farming. I would allow time for a village walk and lunch.
en.Kombinace starého města a blízkého jezer: The old town and nearby lake offer a change after a mountain hike. Another summit is not essential to a rewarding day.
en.Bílé zdi městeček ve Valle d’Itria odráž: The white walls of Valle d’Itria reflect the sun, while two coastlines frame southern Salento. There is more to understanding Puglia than ticking off beaches. I would add an early walk through Bari, an evening in Lecce and a few stops among the olive groves.
en.Nejvíc mě na plánování Apulie zajímá roz: Gargano, central Puglia and Salento offer different balances of towns, countryside and coast. I recommend choosing two neighbouring areas instead of crossing the whole region every day.
en.Na poznávání měst bych vybíral květen ne: I would choose May or September for town visits. In July and August, save longer walks for morning or evening, and prioritise shade and water over another sight.
en.Bari a Lecce lze začlenit do cesty vlake: Bari and Lecce fit into a rail itinerary. For Valle d’Itria and remote beaches, check actual connections and replacement buses; a line on the map is not enough.
en.Před výletem na pobřeží si připrav i jin: Have an alternative coastal outing ready for changing wind and sea conditions. Check afternoon opening at smaller businesses; there is no single closing rule across Puglia.
en.Orecchiette s cime di rapa mohou obsahov: Orecchiette with cime di rapa may contain anchovies. Ask about ingredients if you avoid fish, even when the dish appears to be vegetable-based.
en.Bílé domy se šikmými střechami cummerse: White houses with pitched roofs called cummerse offer a different side of Valle d’Itria from its trulli. I would explore the centre and stop for countryside views.
en.Městečko stojí za zastávku také kvůli mí: The town also deserves a stop for its butcher shops that cook meat for customers. Bombette are stuffed meat rolls; confirm your order and portion size first.
en.V Mateře se domy a skála prolínají tak t: In Matera, houses and rock fit so closely together that the city changes shape as you walk. Beyond it lie rolling inland country and the rocky peaks of the Lucanian Dolomites. I would explore Basilicata as a journey through several landscapes, rather than a quick detour for one photograph.
en.Region má krátký úsek u Tyrhénského moře: Basilicata reaches both the Tyrrhenian and Ionian seas, but much of its character lies inland. I recommend combining Matera with one mountain area and allowing extra time on minor roads.
en.Pro procházky Materou bych vybíral jaro: I would choose spring or autumn for Matera. In summer, break the visit into shorter walks: exposed viewpoints and stone steps feel very different at midday.
en.U Matery prověř spojení také u Ferrovie: Check Ferrovie Appulo Lucane for connections to Matera. For several inland towns, compare driving with actual bus services before committing to an itinerary.
en.Nocleh vybírej i podle přístupu se zavaz: Check luggage access before booking. Historic accommodation may involve steps and a walk from parking; a short straight-line distance can be misleading.
en.Peperoni cruschi nejsou automaticky páli: Peperoni cruschi are not necessarily hot peppers. Ask how they are prepared and enjoy them in their own right, rather than expecting every local dish to centre on meat.
en.Domy stojí těsně pod rozeklanými skalami: Houses sit directly below the jagged Lucanian Dolomites. Rather than driving straight on, I would leave time for the steps, viewpoints and changing light.
en.Ve svahu hledej starou čtvrť Arabata, kd: Look for the Arabata quarter, where houses follow the rock. Combine it with Castelmezzano if you wish, but check walking connections against trail conditions and your fitness.
en.V Benátkách určuje směr chůze další most: In Venice, your next turn depends on a bridge or a boat stop. Beyond the lagoon, Veneto changes into vineyards, the plain around Padua and the rocky Dolomites. I would give the cities and the countryside separate parts of the trip, rather than returning to the same car park every evening.
en.Pohled z laguny vysvětluje jen část regi: The lagoon tells only part of Veneto’s story. Verona, Vicenza and Padua deserve their own time, while vineyards and foothills suit a slower journey. I would combine two cities with one rural area.
en.Na městské procházky bych volil jaro neb: Spring or autumn would be my choice for cities. Plan mountain outings separately around altitude and trail conditions; weather in Venice says little about the Dolomites.
en.Benátky, Padovu, Vicenzu a Veronu bych n: I would first plan Venice, Padua, Vicenza and Verona by train. A car is more useful for selected countryside stops than for moving between historic centres.
en.Pro konkrétní den v Benátkách ověř pravi: Check Venice’s official access-contribution rules for your actual visit date. The calendar changes, and the same payment obligation does not apply to every visitor.
en.U cicchetti si vyber několik různých sou: Choose a few different cicchetti and compare what each bàcaro offers. For fish dishes, ask about bones and check whether the price is per portion or by weight.
en.Obec v Euganejských pahorcích nabídne ka: This village in the Euganean Hills combines stone buildings with memories of the poet Petrarch. I would give it a relaxed visit after a city day, rather than squeeze it into an evening.
en.Městské hradby se dají vnímat jako celek: The walls make more sense as a complete defensive system than as a backdrop to one gate. Walk around part of them, then stop in the centre.
en.Pod boloňskými podloubími lze přejít z r: Under Bologna’s porticoes, a busy street can lead straight to a shop making fresh pasta. Emilia-Romagna also has a coast, wetlands and the Apennines. For a first visit, I would choose a few stops along the Via Emilia and leave proper time for meals between them.
en.Bologna, Modena a Parma dobře ukazují, j: Bologna, Modena and Parma show how closely city life and food production are connected. Romagna brings its own cuisine and Adriatic landscapes. I would avoid turning the journey into a race through famous products.
en.Na města a venkov bych vybíral duben až: I would choose April to June or September and October for towns and countryside. In summer, plan beach days differently from walks through hot city centres.
en.Páteřní města regionu nejdřív porovnej v: Start with trains between the main cities. For a cheese producer or winery, check its exact address and the last leg from the station; it may be well outside town.
en.Prohlídku výrobny rezervuj předem a nech: Book production visits in advance and confirm the language and what is included. For balsamic vinegar, compare the exact designation rather than the bottle’s shape.
en.Tortellini ve vývaru, tagliatelle s ragù: Tortellini in broth, tagliatelle al ragù and piadina belong to different local traditions. I would order accordingly and give the daily menu a chance.
en.Obec pod sádrovcovými skalami stojí za o: Gypsum outcrops, surrounding countryside and local olive oil justify the detour. I would build the day around a walk and one carefully chosen visit.
en.Mosty a kanály v městečku jsou dobrým úv: Bridges and canals introduce the lagoons and the Po Delta. Add a wetland outing after checking which routes or guided visits are currently available.
en.Na terstském nábřeží se vedle sebe potka: On Trieste’s waterfront, the sea meets grand buildings and cafés shaped by Central European history. Behind the city, the land rises through the Karst towards the Alps. Friuli-Venezia Giulia deserves a stay of its own rather than simply being a route to somewhere else.
en.Právě střídání jazyků, kuchyní a krajin: Languages, cooking and landscapes change across this border region. Trieste, Udine, Aquileia and the mountain valleys are distinct experiences. I would choose a city base and allow a separate day for one inland area.
en.Na města a vinice bych vybíral květen, č: For towns and vineyards, I would choose May, June or September. Keep a weather-dependent alternative for mountain days; a coastal forecast is not a mountain forecast.
en.Terst a Udine lze dobře zahrnout do vlak: Trieste and Udine fit into a rail itinerary. Check onward regional services for Cividale and mountain stops. For winery visits, consider arranged transport or a non-drinking driver.
en.Když předpověď pro Terst hlásí silnou bó: If strong bora winds are forecast for Trieste, adapt waterfront walks and outdoor plans. Book winery visits ahead and keep tasting separate from driving.
en.U frica se zeptej na podobu pokrmu: měkk: Ask which kind of frico is served: the soft potato version is a different meal from crisp fried cheese. I would taste Collio wines in small pours.
en.U řeky Natisone se zastav kvůli langobar: Stop by the Natisone for Lombard heritage and views from the bridge. Check monument opening hours first, leaving time for the town itself.
en.Opevněná obec vypráví také o obnově po z: The fortified town also tells the story of reconstruction after the 1976 earthquake. Explore the restored streets as a whole rather than stopping for one photograph of the walls.
en.Pod Tropeou leží pláž, za pobřežím ale b: A beach lies below Tropea, but behind the coast the land quickly rises into hills and forested mountains. Staying in one seaside resort can reduce Calabria to a swimming holiday. I would add a day for inland towns and another for the region’s natural landscapes.
en.Tyrhénská a jónská strana nemají stejný: The Tyrrhenian and Ionian coasts need different itineraries. I would choose one stretch and its neighbouring inland area, rather than lose each day to driving across the region.
en.Pro poznávání bych zvažoval květen, červ: May, June or September would be my choice for sightseeing. Avoid midday climbs in summer and pack an extra layer for the mountains, even if the coast is warm.
en.Pobřežní města nejdřív porovnej v železn: Check coastal towns against current train timetables. A car may help link inland villages, but allow enough time for winding roads and parking.
en.Nezaměňuj značku ubytování blízko moře s: An address near the sea does not guarantee an easy walk to the beach. Check slopes and steps before booking, especially with equipment or reduced mobility.
en.’Nduju bych ochutnal nejdřív v malém mno: I would try ’nduja in a small amount first. Its heat should not overwhelm the meal; ask for a non-spicy preparation of fish or vegetables if that suits you better.
en.Staré město nad jónským pobřežím stojí z: The old town above the Ionian coast deserves time for its stone streets and cathedral. I would alternate visits inside with views across the landscape.
en.Malá byzantská Cattolica s pěti kupolemi: The small Byzantine Cattolica with five domes reveals another side of the south. Check access and opening times before making the detour.
en.Nad Neapolským zálivem je Vesuv vidět i: Vesuvius remains part of the view across the Bay of Naples whether you are having coffee or waiting for a boat. In Campania, volcanic landscapes are woven into everyday city life. I recommend combining Naples with a few excursions that work together geographically and by public transport.
en.Neapol, archeologické areály, ostrovy a: Naples, archaeological sites, islands and the Amalfi Coast each need their own plan. In the city I would walk and use public transport. A free day between outings leaves room for weather changes and rest.
en.Pro město a vykopávky bych vybíral jaro: Spring or autumn would be my choice for Naples and archaeological sites. In summer, visit exposed areas early and leave part of the day for shade or a museum.
en.Pompeje, Herculaneum a další cíle si roz: Plan Pompeii, Herculaneum and other stops around actual stations and operators. Compare boats for Amalfi and the islands, remembering that seasons and sea conditions affect services.
en.Na Vesuv ověř zvlášť vstup, dopravu a pě: Check Vesuvius admission, transport and the walking section separately. For volcanic areas, follow current park, INGV and civil-protection information rather than assuming access shown in an older film remains available.
en.V Neapoli bych objednal jednu pizzu a ne: In Naples I would order one pizza and leave room for another stop later. Choose mozzarella by origin and freshness rather than the photograph on the menu.
en.Ostrov nabízí přístavní zástavbu a pohle: Harbour houses and a different view across the bay make this a day in its own right. Choose a return sailing rather than squeezing Procida between two other islands.
en.Řecké chrámy jižně od Salerna zasazují a: Greek temples south of Salerno place ancient history in an open landscape. I would plan the site and museum together, allowing shade breaks on a hot day.
en.V Římě se dá během krátké procházky přej: A short walk through Rome can take you from ancient walls to a busy square and a café. Lazio continues beyond the capital to lakes, tuff cliffs and the coast. I would give Rome its own time and treat trips outside the city as another chapter.
en.Největší rozdíl je mezi intenzitou hlavn: The contrast between Rome and the smaller places around it is part of Lazio’s appeal. Tivoli, the Viterbo area and the coast lie in different directions; I would not combine them into one rushed day.
en.Pro delší procházky Římem bych vybíral j: For long walks through Rome, I would choose spring or autumn. Reserve major sights for specific times, but leave gaps rather than filling every hour.
en.Do Říma a mezi většími městy nejdřív por: Start with trains for Rome and other larger towns. For Civita di Bagnoregio and smaller coastal destinations, check the final bus connection and return, particularly at weekends.
en.Historické centrum není místo pro hledán: Plan parking before driving towards a historic centre. Check ZTL restrictions, accommodation access and official ticket conditions. Remember that Vatican City is a separate state.
en.Cacio e pepe vypadá jednoduše, ale vypla: Cacio e pepe deserves attention as a dish in its own right. Carbonara and amatriciana contain meat; ask about a suitable alternative before ordering if needed.
en.Obec na tufovém ostrohu je přístupná pěš: Reach the village on its tuff spur by walking over the bridge. Allow time from the car park and check entry conditions: a small settlement can still attract many visitors.
en.Bílá zástavba nad pobřežím nabízí jiný d: White buildings above the coast offer a different day from a Roman museum. Explore the town, then add a nearby archaeological visit or time by the sea.
en.V Ligurii se mezi moře a prudký svah čas: In Liguria, a railway, a road and a narrow strip of houses often share the space between the sea and a steep hillside. A nearby place on the map does not necessarily mean a quick drive. I recommend choosing one stretch of coast and exploring it by train, on foot and, when services allow, by boat.
en.Janov je velké přístavní město, Cinque T: Genoa’s port, the villages and hillside paths of Cinque Terre, and the bay around Lerici need their own time. A few nights in one base make it easier to adapt to the weather without constant packing.
en.Na procházky bych vybíral jaro nebo září: I would choose spring or September and October for walking, guided by the forecast. After heavy rain, check the trail status even if the following morning looks fine.
en.Pro hlavní pobřežní zastávky bych nejprv: Start with trains for the main coastal stops. Check seasonal boat timetables and the return journey; smaller destinations may need an additional bus or walk.
en.Pro Cinque Terre ověř konkrétní stezku,: For Cinque Terre, check the chosen path, any fee and footwear requirements with the park. A sea view does not make a steep trail a level promenade.
en.Pesto bych ochutnal s místními těstovina: I would try pesto with local pasta and focaccia as a separate snack. Ask about nuts and cheese in prepared sauces if ingredients or allergies matter to you.
en.Domy se skládají kolem malého pobřežního: Houses cluster around the small centre and waterfront church. I would combine Tellaro with Lerici, arranging transport beforehand so the visit is not spent hunting for parking.
en.Na západním pobřeží si všimni středověký: Look for medieval towers and the town’s relationship with the sea. Noli offers a western Ligurian stop beyond the most photographed eastern villages.
en.Ráno může začít mezi milánskými tramvaje: One morning might begin among Milan’s trams and the next aboard a boat below the slopes of Lake Como. Lombardy offers very different kinds of trip. I would choose one as the main focus and add the other as a carefully planned excursion.
en.Milán, staré Bergamo, jižní rovina a alp: Milan, old Bergamo, the southern plain and Alpine valleys offer very different scales of travel. I would give the lakes their own time for waterfront walks and boat journeys rather than fit them between distant cities.
en.Na města a nižší polohy bych vybíral jar: Spring or autumn would be my choice for towns and lower ground. Plan mountains separately around snow and trail opening: lakeside walks and high-altitude hikes have different seasons.
en.Milán a řadu dalších měst porovnej u Tre: Check Trenord and Trenitalia for Milan and other towns. At the lakes, combine rail travel with Navigazione Laghi boats, checking seasonal timetables and the type of service.
en.Auto bych do historických center nebral: Check restricted traffic zones and parking before driving into historic centres. For lakeside accommodation, look at the climb from the station as well as the distance.
en.Milánské risotto a jídla z Valtelliny by: I would choose Milanese risotto or Valtellina dishes according to where I am. For mountain wines, ask about the actual growing area and grape rather than simply looking for Lombardy.
en.Město navržené jako renesanční celek se: This planned Renaissance town reveals its layout as you walk between squares and walls. I would naturally combine it with Mantua rather than drive back across the region.
en.Obec na východní straně jezera Como nabí: The village on Como’s eastern shore combines waterfront walks with boat excursions. Check actual sailing times before designing a circuit between harbours.
en.Nad Jadranem u Conera vystupují svahy ze: Green slopes rise above the Adriatic at Conero, while inland towns stand on hilltops among the fields. I would explore Marche in shorter stages between the sea and the Apennines. Each area deserves more time than it takes to collect another photograph.
en.Urbino, Ascoli Piceno a Ancona dávají re: Urbino, Ascoli Piceno and Ancona reveal different urban sides of Marche. The countryside between them deserves attention too. For a first visit, I would choose the north or south and add a coastal day.
en.Pro města a kopcovitou krajinu bych vybí: For towns and hills, I would choose May, June or September. Plan swimming and walks in the Sibillini separately around actual conditions.
Check trains first for coastal destinations. For hill towns, find the station’s location and onward bus. Several inland stops may be easier to link by car.
en.Před horským výletem ověř průchodnost ce: Check mountain trail access with the park. Confirm the opening of individual monuments too: an accessible town centre does not mean every building is open.
en.Olive all’ascolana jsou plněné masem, ne: Olive all’ascolana are meat-filled, rather than a vegetarian snack. For Verdicchio, compare growing areas; the grape’s name alone cannot describe every bottle.
en.Opevněná obec s hradem nabídne soustředě: The castle and fortified village make a focused stop in northern Marche. I would explore the settlement and add a booked castle visit if it interests you.
en.Ve starém městě se potkávají krajkářská: Lacemaking traditions meet the wines of the surrounding hills. Stop between Ascoli Piceno and the coast instead of simply following the signs to the beach.
en.Z přístavu v Termoli vede cesta do regio: From Termoli’s harbour, the journey leads inland to hilltop towns and archaeological sites away from the main roads. I would choose Molise for a trip with fewer stops and more time at each. Changing accommodation every evening would defeat the point.
en.Pobřeží zabírá jen část regionu; velká č: The coast is only one part of Molise; inland journeys lead to Campobasso, Isernia and mountain villages. I would pair a town with one nearby destination and allow transfer time. A small region does not guarantee quick connections.
en.Pro vnitrozemské procházky bych vybíral: Spring or early autumn would be my choice for inland walks. In winter, expect different conditions in mountain villages and on the coast.
en.Termoli nejdřív porovnej jako vlakový cí: Consider Termoli first as a rail destination. For smaller villages, check current bus services and operating days. I would avoid changing bases repeatedly without confirmed connections.
en.Na delší cestu autem si připrav zásobu č: Allow spare time and bring food for longer drives. Check small restaurants and craft businesses directly rather than assuming they remain open throughout the afternoon.
en.Cavatelli mají víc podob úpravy; objedná: Cavatelli come with different preparations; I would choose a seasonal sauce. When tasting cheese, ask about its origin and maturation instead of choosing only by portion size.
en.Zbytky římského města pomáhají představi: Roman remains make the town’s layout and everyday life easier to imagine. Check access and activities with the site manager before assuming all areas can be visited.
en.Město je spojené s výrobou zvonů a řemes: The town is associated with bell-making and other crafts. Arrange any workshop or museum visit before arriving rather than relying on an unplanned call.
en.Turínské podloubí má jiné tempo než cest: Turin’s porticoes have a different rhythm from a drive along the vineyard ridges of the Langhe. The Alps remain close to both sides of Piedmont. I recommend combining the city with one wine-growing or lake area, and planning the high mountains separately.
en.Region bych si nespojoval jen s jedním v: Piedmont is more than one wine or museum. Turin suits walking and trams, the countryside invites short stops, and lakes offer boat journeys. Choose which landscape you want outside your door before booking a base.
en.Na město a vinice bych zvažoval květen,: I would consider May, June or September and October for towns and vineyards. An autumn visit does not guarantee truffles or availability at a tasting: arrange both ahead.
en.Turín nejdřív naplánuj bez auta. U okruh: Plan Turin without a car first. For wine villages, compare arranged transfers or local tours, or appoint a driver who will not take part in tastings.
en.Jezerní a horský den nech pružný podle p: Keep lake and mountain days flexible around the weather. Check boats and route conditions with the operator rather than relying on an all-season photograph.
en.Tajarin bych volil v menší porci, pokud: I would choose a small portion of tajarin if another course follows. Confirm truffle pricing and origin beforehand; for Barolo and Barbaresco, compare vintages and producers.
en.Menší jezero Orta a výhledy od Sacro Mon: Lake Orta and the views from Sacro Monte offer a change from large city squares. I would allow separate time for the shore walk and a possible island boat trip.
en.Sacro Monte propojuje krajinu s kaplemi: Sacro Monte brings landscape, chapels and visual storytelling together. Give it uninterrupted time rather than rushing to the first viewpoint and leaving.
en.Sardinie má za známými plážemi kamenné v: Beyond Sardinia’s well-known beaches lie stone nuraghi, mountain roads and towns with their own traditions. The colour of the sea tells only part of the story. I recommend choosing one area of the island and balancing beach days with trips inland.
en.Cagliari, Alghero, Gallura a Ogliastra n: Cagliari, Alghero, Gallura and Ogliastra are not neighbouring stops. Each needs a different plan. I would save one area for another trip rather than spend every day driving a long way to a new beach.
en.Pro kombinaci výletů a pobřeží bych vybí: For coast and inland outings, I would choose late spring or September. A May trip should not depend on warm seawater and swimming every day.
en.Přílet nebo trajekt vybírej podle oblast: Choose an airport or ferry port to suit your chosen area, not just the cheapest fare. Check public transport for towns; consider a car for several remote stops in one day.
en.U vybrané pláže nebo chráněného území ov: Check reservations, visitor limits and access rules for the chosen beach or protected area. If bringing a car by ferry, allow for check-in and the drive from port.
en.Culurgiones bych ochutnal i kvůli náplni: I would try culurgiones for their filling as much as their shape. Coastal and mountain menus can differ; exploring both is part of discovering the island.
en.Domy pod hradem a město u řeky Temo nabí: Houses below the castle and the town beside the Temo offer a change from beach days. I would explore the centre and allow time for a wider view of the town.
en.Zástavba pod hradem stoupá na pobřežním: Houses climb a coastal headland below the castle. Plan around the temperature and your willingness to climb, rather than simply taking the nearest available parking space.
en.Na trhu v Palermu se o pozornost dělí hl: At Palermo’s markets, stallholders’ voices compete with displays of fish, vegetables and freshly fried food. On the eastern side of Sicily, Etna takes over the horizon. I would explore the island in sections: the journey between these two experiences deserves more than a hurried transfer.
en.Antická města, arabské a normanské stopy: Ancient cities, Arab and Norman traces, baroque towns and volcanic landscapes each need time. For a first visit I would choose east or west and stay several nights in one area. A whole-island circuit needs enough days for real stops.
en.Na města a archeologické areály bych vyb: For towns and archaeological sites, I would choose April, May or autumn. In summer, explore exposed places early and use the hottest hours for shade or interiors.
en.Mezi hlavními městy porovnej vlak i auto: Compare trains and buses between main towns, checking actual journey times. A car can help with smaller places; check restricted access zones and parking before entering historic centres.
en.Výlet na Etnu plánuj podle aktuálních om: Plan Etna around current access restrictions and the managing authority’s instructions. Summit access changes: an old itinerary or summit photograph is not proof that the route is open today.
en.Arancini nebo arancine bych bral jako oc: I would choose arancini or arancine for the filling rather than argue about one correct name. For cannoli, ask when they are filled and what is inside.
en.Kamenné město nad Trapani nabízí výhledy: The stone town above Trapani can have different weather from the coast below. Account for the ascent and current transport operation, not just the short distance on the map.
en.Barokní město v jihovýchodní části ostro: I would include this southeastern baroque town in the same part of the trip as Ragusa and Modica. Give it a walk of its own instead of rushing through all three.
en.Cypřišová cesta ve Val d’Orcia je jen je: A cypress-lined road in Val d’Orcia is one Tuscan scene; another waits in Siena’s square or among houses above the vineyards. I would divide the trip between cities and countryside. Moving between these two sides of Tuscany makes sense without a long drive every day.
en.Florencie, Siena, jižní kopce a přímořsk: Florence, Siena, the southern hills and coastal Maremma need more than one continuous drive. I recommend several nights in one area. In the countryside, leave time to stop and look rather than simply chase another familiar photograph.
en.Na města a procházky bych vybíral květen: For towns and walking, I would choose May, June or September and October. In summer, reduce exposed midday stops and start earlier instead.
en.Florencii a Pisu lze dobře zahrnout do v: Florence and Pisa fit a rail itinerary. For several Val d’Orcia stops, compare a car with actual bus services, arranging parking before entering historic centres.
en.Ochutnávku vína si domluv s bezpečným ná: Arrange wine tastings with a safe return. Check current access and bathing conditions at thermal sites: a photograph of open water does not guarantee unrestricted, round-the-clock entry.
en.Pici bych ochutnal podle místní omáčky a: I would try pici with a local sauce and compare pecorino at different stages of maturation. At a tasting, choose contrasting wines rather than order every famous name.
en.Zástavba nad tufovou skálou stojí za poh: The town above the tuff cliffs deserves views from outside and a walk through its streets. For the sunken vie cave paths, check the chosen section and wear suitable footwear.
en.Menší obec v krajině tufových skal může: This smaller village in the tuff landscape pairs naturally with Pitigliano. Add an archaeological visit if it interests you, checking opening arrangements beforehand.
en.Pod skalami Dolomit se v údolích střídaj: Below the rocky Dolomites, the valleys contain vineyards, orchards and towns shaped by several language traditions. Trentino and South Tyrol share a mountain setting but have distinct identities. I recommend choosing one valley as a base and planning excursions from there.
en.Trento, Bolzano, okolí Gardy a vysoko po: Trento, Bolzano, the Garda area and the high valleys offer different holidays. Temperature, trails and transport change between town and mountain. I would not change bases daily simply for another photographed lake.
en.Pro údolní města bych volil jaro nebo po: I would choose spring or autumn for valley towns. For high mountain walks, follow snow conditions and hut or trail openings; a June booking alone does not guarantee summer conditions.
en.Nejdřív porovnej regionální dopravu u Tr: Check Trentino Trasporti and südtirolmobil before relying on a car. For cable cars, verify the last descent and connecting bus to avoid an unplanned long walk down.
en.Horské počasí kontroluj průběžně a připr: Keep checking mountain weather and have a shorter alternative. Verify road, parking and lake access for the actual day: seasonal transport or booking arrangements may apply.
en.Canederli mohou být samostatný sytý chod: Canederli can be a filling main course rather than a side dish. I would compare local cheeses and an apple dessert, distinguishing Trentino from South Tyrol when choosing wine.
en.Kamenná obec nad severním koncem Gardy s: This stone village above northern Lake Garda suits a day with a shorter walk. Combine it with Lake Tenno according to available time and the current walking route.
en.Opevněné městečko ve Val Venosta nabízí: The walled town in Val Venosta offers a change from cable-car excursions. I would leave time to explore the centre and walk beside the walls.
en.V Umbrii se mezi olivovníky a poli zveda: In Umbria, towns rise above olive groves and fields, and reaching their historic centres often means an uphill walk. There is no coast to add to the itinerary. Instead, I would alternate town visits and countryside with a day at Lake Trasimeno or in the mountains.
en.Assisi, Perugia a Orvieto mají každé vla: Assisi, Perugia and Orvieto each deserve a visit, but so does the landscape between them. I would choose one area and neighbouring stops rather than commute between distant towns every day.
en.Na města a venkov bych vybíral květen, č: For towns and countryside, I would choose May, June or September and October. Begin uphill walks early in summer; check smaller attractions’ opening times in winter.
en.U příjezdu vlakem zjisti, kde přesně lež: For rail arrivals, check the station’s exact location relative to the old town. At Orvieto and Assisi, onward transport and the climb are part of the journey.
en.Před vjezdem autem ověř ZTL a místo k pa: Check ZTL restrictions and parking before driving into town. For Sibillini walks, confirm current trail access with the park rather than relying on an old navigation track.
en.U lanýžových jídel si nech vysvětlit pou: Ask which truffle ingredient is used and whether it is in season. I would try lentil or vegetable soup alongside cured meats, checking the stock before ordering.
en.Kamenné centrum a ulice ve svahu se hodí: The stone centre and hillside streets suit a shorter walk. If you want to see the Infiorate flower festival, check its actual date: the decorations are not there all year.
en.Město v údolní krajině nabízí příjemnou: This valley town offers a change from hilltop centres. I would combine it with the Montefalco area, arranging return transport before booking a wine tasting.
en.Nad údolím Aosty se zvedají vysoké alpsk: High Alpine massifs rise above the Aosta Valley, while Roman remains and castles line the valley below. I would not plan the entire region around a single cable car. Combining valley stops with mountain outings makes more sense, with the latter chosen to suit the weather and your fitness.
en.Dvojjazyčné názvy a horská kuchyně připo: Bilingual place names and mountain cooking recall nearby France, while Aosta preserves Roman remains. Several towns fit a journey along the main valley, but side valleys need their own time. Short map distances can hide long mountain journeys.
en.Pro Aostu a hrady bych zvažoval jaro neb: Spring or autumn would be my choice for Aosta and the castles. Base high mountain outings on current snow, wind and lift opening; good valley weather may not extend to altitude.
en.Před příjezdem ověř současné vlakové a a: Check current trains and buses, including replacement services, before arrival. A car may help link castles, but choose accommodation according to where your actual outings begin.
en.Při cestě přes průsmyk nebo tunelem si z: For passes and tunnels, check opening, equipment requirements and tolls with the operator. Do not assume a road used in summer will be open in winter.
en.Fontinu bych porovnal i samotnou před ob: I would taste Fontina on its own before ordering a hot cheese dish. Fonduta and cheese polenta are filling; smaller orders leave room to explore without wasting food.
en.Obec pod výraznou pevností je dobrým zas: The village below the fortress makes a useful valley stop. Choose exhibitions and visits by the current programme and opening times, not just the building’s photograph.
en.Obec v údolí směrem k Velkému svatému Be: On the way towards the Great St Bernard Pass, this village offers another side of local mountain architecture. I would visit it properly rather than treat it as a last-minute break.

Tritare finemente la carota, il sedano e la cipolla. Tritare la pancetta a pezzetti.

Tritare finemente la carota, il sedano e la cipolla. Tritare la pancetta a pezzetti. Soffriggere la pancetta nell'olio, aggiungere le verdure e lasciarle appassire a fuoco lento. Aggiungete la carne di manzo e fatela rosolare bene; rompere i grumi con un cucchiaio di legno. Aggiungere il vino rosso e lasciar bollire. Unire la passata e un po' di brodo caldo. Cuocere lentamente per almeno 2 ore, mescolando di tanto in tanto. Quando il ragù sarà asciutto aggiungere un po' di brodo. Alla fine dovrebbe essere spesso; condire con sale e pepe. Lessare le tagliatelle in acqua salata come indicato sulla confezione. Tenete da parte un bicchiere di acqua della pasta prima di scolarla. Mescolare le tagliatelle al ragù. Se la salsa dovesse risultare troppo densa aggiungete un cucchiaio di acqua della pasta e servite subito.

La temperatura della zona può essere impostata direttamente dal chiosco in mezzi gradi, mentre in modalità automatica ha la precedenza la selezione manuale.
Boost sul chiosco usato per aggiungere il doppio, ora aggiunge correttamente.
La testina termica della zona volutamente spenta, dove la valvola è difettosa, non segnala più errori o batteria scarica.
Un nuovo strumento di controllo mattutino verifica che l’oscuramento notturno sia andato come previsto e sottrae le correzioni dell’intelligenza artificiale e il riscaldamento mattutino del bagno per evitare falsi allarmi.
Due notti in modalità automatica sono trascorse senza risultati e la prima vera partenza dall'appartamento ha portato tutte le zone a 16 °C.
